gates.name: B3 sweep
gates.threshold: the brake is fixed (bone muzzle_device, joint fixed)

look_check: by eye at 2x and 3-4x zooms of review/detail/muzzle_brake/r2b_i10_pair_c3.png vs the reference: slot shape and position, rim band, groove + step junction and the pinned detent block now read like c3. Remaining differences I can still see: the body is longer than c3 draws it relative to its diameter (the side views and the 880 / 31.2 key dims fix the length), the lower outline slopes down to the chin more than c3's, the block is lighter and cleaner than c3's dark worn lump, and the ROUGH LOOK has no wear (render, not design). The FSB's cleaning-rod lug at the window's lower left is not in our window (FSB part; c3 compresses the FSB-to-muzzle distance ~27 %).
